                        uid=2_219 "For the first time, this is a full-size Raspberry Pi computer using silicon built in-house at Raspberry Pi. - **Adafruit**: Used the site search (`/search?q=raspberry+pi+5`), found "Raspberry Pi 5 - 8 GB RAM" in the results, then confirmed the `$200.00` price on its product page (`.product-price` element).
